label: Synthetic staffing assumptions; not a clinical staffing policy
forecast_assumptions: Six rolling 15-minute intervals use clinician work-minutes; concurrency is one globally shared slot per physician.
Current fresh connectivity and availability are conditionally carried into the forecast; this is not guaranteed future attendance.
Known assignments use their supplied expected end; actual assignment eligibility still requires completion evidence.
Scheduled capacity and explicit accepted assignment blocks are included; unaccepted off-shift offers add no capacity.
Backlog carries into later bins; each hospital's arrival work assumption is a demo input, not a clinical prediction.
Deadline ordering uses source-provided urgency; the application does not create clinical priorities.
